mission_priority: XRP intelligence and measured prediction-engine mastery

research_method.source_policy: Use public lawful sources; distinguish first-party statements, platform attribution, secondary reporting and third-party indexing.
research_method.source_independence: Multiple aggregators repeating the same YouTube channel metadata are one dependent evidence cluster, not independent identity confirmations.

primary_source.name: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (Tokyo SBIC)
primary_source.page_title: Manufacturing Generative AI and Machine Learning Introductory Training
primary_source.evidence: The official SBIC training page lists ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot in a generative-AI training curriculum.
primary_source.audience: The course page says investee companies are eligible at the stated investment-company price and general companies cannot attend.
primary_source.interpretation: This establishes an SBIC educational course that taught ChatGPT; it does not establish an OpenAI partnership, ChatGPT product integration, shared ownership or a separate entity named 'ChatGPT SBIC'.

sbic_chatgpt.entity_separation: Tokyo SBIC is a regional Japanese investment-and-consultation company; it is not SBI Holdings. East/Central/West regional SBIC companies remain separate from SBI Holdings.

ask_coin_exchange.direct_domain_result: The askcoin.net request redirected to a HugeDomains domain-profile/parking page during this capture.
ask_coin_exchange.interpretation: No evidence establishes an operating exchange, verifiable reserves, current liquidity or an XRP relationship.

permission_coin_ask_token.name: Permission Coin
permission_coin_ask_token.distinction: This is a token in the Permission ecosystem, not the Ask Coin exchange listing. It is described as an omnichain token on Base and Polygon.

askclash.name: AskClash
askclash.distinction: A separate AI market-intelligence product; no relationship to Ask Coin or XRP was established.

exact_phrase_use.context: The article uses the phrase 'Ripple's actual capital' while discussing RLUSD and Ripple's regulated stablecoin strategy.

actual_capital.accounting_rule: Do not treat 'actual capital' as a standardized financial metric. Reconcile capacity, committed financing, gross cash received, net cash proceeds, recognized revenue, cash deployed, XRP acquired and outstanding debt separately.

claim_quality_controls.reason: Secondary article says banks were unnamed and source documents were not provided.
